Psomagen, Inc.

is a U.S. genomics services company headquartered in Maryland, operating CLIA/CAP-certified laboratories. We provide sequencing, single-cell, spatial, proteomics and bioinformatics services to academic, foundation, pharma and clinical customers. We are building AI into how the company operates, so that our teams spend less time on routine work and more time on science and customers.

About The Role

We are looking for a hands-on developer with real AI agent experience to lead Psomagen's company-wide AI transformation. You will design, build and operate AI agents on top of the tools our teams use every day: Google Workspace, HubSpot, our in-house LIMS and SAP. You will work directly with the CEO and with every function, identify where agents can remove manual work, ship them quickly, and keep them reliable in production. This is a builder role, not an advisory one.

What You'll Do

Design, develop and operate AI agents using Hermes and comparable agent frameworks, and keep the underlying models swappable as better ones appear
Connect agents to our business systems (Google Workspace, HubSpot, LIMS, SAP) and choose the right way to integrate each one, so that agents can read, draft and act within defined permissions
Work with sales, project management, lab operations, finance, regulatory/quality and IT to find high-value workflows (for example quoting, customer communication, document management, reporting and internal Q&A) and turn them into working agents
Build the supporting infrastructure: knowledge retrieval over company documents, evaluation and testing of agent outputs, logging, monitoring and cost control
Put guardrails in place: role-based access, audit trails and human approval steps for actions that touch customers, finance or regulated records
Collaborate with our LIMS development and bioinformatics teams so that agents fit our existing systems and pipelines
Train employees to use agents effectively, gather feedback and keep improving what is deployed
Track new AI models, tools and practices, and bring in the ones that make a practical difference to the business

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in computer science, software engineering or a related field
4+ years of professional software development experience, with strong Python skills
Demonstrated experience building and operating LLM-based agents in production or in substantial real-world use (tool calling, multi-step workflows, retrieval, prompt and context design, evaluation)
Current knowledge of frontier AI models and agent tooling, with the ability to explain trade-offs among models, frameworks and cost
Experience connecting software or agents to business systems (for example Google Workspace, HubSpot, an ERP such as SAP, or similar), including authentication and permission design
Strong communication skills, and comfort working with non-technical colleagues to understand their workflows
Awareness of data security and privacy requirements when AI handles customer, financial or health-related data
Legally authorized to work in the U.S.

Preferred

Experience with Hermes or similar open agent frameworks, and with Google Cloud
Hands-on experience with Google Workspace administration and APIs, Apps Script, and HubSpot
Experience with LIMS, SAP or other laboratory and enterprise operations systems
Domain knowledge of sequencing services or genomics, especially bioinformatics (pipelines, workflow tools such as Airflow, QC and reporting)
Experience in a regulated environment (CLIA/CAP, ISO 9001 or ISO 27001)
Experience with SQL and data pipelines

Join the elite technical and product engine of the Accenture Google Business Group (AGBG). We are not a traditional project delivery organization; we are a practice of innovators and builders guiding our clients through the most significant shift in technology: the move to Agentic AI and Product-Led Operating Models. As a Google Cloud Platform (GCP) Agentic AI Delivery Senior Engineer, you are a new breed of technologist—a "product-minded engineer" who is as fluent in the language of code as you are in the language of customer outcomes. You don't just build solutions; you leverage the best of technologies Google Cloud has to offer for client requirements, helping clients break free from legacy solution mindset and practices to build truly modern, value-driven software products on Google Cloud.

You Are:

A passionate, hands-on GCP Senior Engineer who understands that great software is not just about elegant code, but about solving real problems leveraging the best technology tools available for a client. You are as comfortable building a multi-agent workflow on Vertex AI as you are testing a solution built by other team members in a compressed timeline, leveraging the various tools and technologies of Google Cloud. You have a consultative mindset and a deep curiosity to understand the "why" behind a client's business requirements and convert them to an optimal technology solution. You are an evangelist for modern ways of working, grounded in the principles of Product-Led engineering and operating models and related approaches. You are an exceptional communicator, great team player, continuous learner and a true believer in continual change.

The Work:

As a GCP Agentic AI Delivery Senior Engineer, you will be a technical and product-centric engineer in consulting and engineering projects, customizing Google Cloud Agentic solutions for client requirements. You will partner with Accenture's global delivery teams by providing superior technical expertise and product innovation skills. Your role is to execute complex technology solutions for our clients by designing, building, and demonstrating Agentic AI solutions. You will act as a trusted team player, guiding others in the team on how to adopt a Product Engineering mindset and be the expert on specific Google Cloud technologies/products.

Key Responsibilities:

Outcome-Driven Design and Build: Actively participate in technical discovery workshops to translate client business requirements into GCP technology design elements and customized solutions. added.title: Data Scientist I
added.description:
Information and Transform

If you are a current Duly/SBC/QMG employee, please apply through the Internal Career Site.

At Duly Health and Care
, you are supported to do your best work and make a meaningful impact every day. You will be part of a collaborative, physician-led team that works as one and puts patients at the center of everything we do.

With a connected network of providers, care teams, and services across primary and specialty care, surgery centers, imaging, lab, and therapy, you are part of a system designed to deliver high-quality, coordinated care. Together, we create an environment where you can grow, contribute, and help improve the experience and outcomes for every patient we serve.

Benefits

Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits that include healthcare navigation assistance.
Access to a mental health benefit at no cost.
Employer provided life and disability insurance.
$5,250 Tuition Reimbursement per year.
Immediate 401(k) match.
40 hours paid volunteer time off.
A culture committed to community engagement and social impact.
Up to 12 weeks parental leave at 100% pay and a financial benefit for adoption and surrogacy for non-physician team members once eligibility requirements are met.

Primary Purpose

The Data Scientist I is an early-career role within the Data & Analytics team, working with the AI/ML team to build predictive models and generative AI solutions that improve patient care, operations, and the colleague experience. This position supports the full lifecycle of data science work, from exploring data and developing models to testing, deploying, and monitoring them, with a growing emphasis on large language model (LLM) applications. The role is well suited to someone with strong quantitative and programming skills who is eager to apply machine learning and GenAI in a healthcare setting. No prior healthcare or Epic experience is required; we will train you.

Major Responsibilities

Predictive modeling and machine learning (40%)

Develop, validate, and document predictive models (e.g., classification, regression, forecasting, risk stratification) using enterprise data
Perform exploratory data analysis, feature engineering, and model evaluation
Support deployment, monitoring, and retraining of models using the organization's ML platform and MLOps practices
Translate model results into clear findings, visualizations, and recommendations for stakeholders

Generative AI and LLM solutions (40%)

Help design, prototype, and test LLM-powered applications such as document summarization, text extraction, question answering, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) solutions
Develop and refine prompts, and evaluate output quality, accuracy, bias, and safety
Support the creation of evaluation frameworks and testing datasets for GenAI use cases
Follow organizational standards for responsible AI, data privacy, and the protection of PHI/PII
Document model designs, assumptions, limitations, and release notes

Collaboration and continuous improvement (20%)

Partner with data engineers, architects, analysts, and business stakeholders to define problems and identify high-value AI/ML use cases
Communicate technical concepts to non-technical audiences, including clinical and operational leaders
Learn from senior data scientists through code reviews and mentoring
Stay current with advances in machine learning and generative AI and share learnings with the team
All other duties as assigned

Minimum Education And Experience

Bachelor's degree in data science, statistics, mathematics, computer science, engineering, or a related quantitative field; or 2 years of related experience; or an equivalent combination of education and experience
0-2 years of experience applying machine learning or statistical modeling (internships, research, capstone projects, and academic coursework count)
Proficiency in Python (e.g., pandas, scikit-learn) and SQL
Experience with LLMs, prompt engineering, or GenAI frameworks beneficial
Experience with Databricks, MLflow, or other cloud ML platforms (Azure preferred) beneficial
Master's degree in a quantitative field a plus
Healthcare or Epic experience not required; training provided

Minimum Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities (KSA)

Solid foundation in statistics, probability, and machine learning concepts
Ability to build and evaluate models and avoid pitfalls such as overfitting and data leakage
Understanding of how LLMs work, including their strengths and limitations
Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills
Strong communication skills and the ability to explain results to all levels of the organization
Ability to work both independently and in a team-oriented environment
Intellectual curiosity and a desire to learn and adopt new AI techniques
Awareness of ethical AI, model bias, and data privacy considerations helpful

If you are committed to putting our patients first and helping shape the future of care, you belong at Duly.

The compensation for this role includes a base pay range of $65,000 - $85,000, with the actual pay determined by factors such as skills, experience, education, certifications, geographic location, and internal equity. Additional compensation may be available through shift differentials, bonuses, and other incentives. Base pay is only a portion of the total rewards package.

Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools may be used in some portions of the candidate review process for this position, however, all employment decisions will be made by a person.

added.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
added.description:
Most boards and executives are currently flying blind when it comes to cyber risk. They are guessing. At Safe, we’ve built an AI-driven engine that finally gives the C-Suite a clear, quantified, and real-time view of their security posture. We don’t just provide data; we provide certainty
.

We are a $170M Series C-funded
category leader. We don’t play in the mid-market; we operate at the highest levels of global enterprise. Today, we are proud to serve 10% of the Fortune 500
, protecting global icons such as Apple, Netflix, AT&T, Verizon, and Victoria’s Secret
.
As we scale toward our next chapter, we are looking for high-performers who want to do the best work of their careers at the intersection of AI and Cybersecurity.

The Culture Memo: Our Operating System

Safe is not a typical corporate environment. We are a high-intensity, mission-driven team. We value builders who want to define a category and work alongside people who are equally committed to excellence.
Extreme Ownership:
We don’t do "not my job." We hire people who see a gap and own the solution from start to finish.
The Elite Standard:
We serve the most sophisticated companies on the planet. Our work must be bulletproof. Whether it’s a line of code or a sales deck, we aim for Tier-1 quality every time.
Methodology & Rigor:
We don’t wing it. From Force Management
and MEDDICC
in sales to data-driven sprints
in engineering, we rely on proven frameworks to stay disciplined and predictable.
Radical Candor:
We move too fast for politics or sugar-coating. We value direct, honest feedback that helps us find the right answer quickly.
The Series C Hustle:
We have the stability of a well-funded leader but the heart of a startup.

The Perks & Ownership:

We want our team to feel like owners because they are
owners. We trust our people to manage their results and their time.
Meaningful Equity:
Every "Safestar" is a shareholder. You aren’t just an employee; you are a partner in our success.
Unlimited Leaves:
We don’t believe in clock-watching. We offer unlimited leave
because we trust you to take the time you need to recharge while staying committed to the mission.
Comprehensive Benefits:
We provide top-tier medical insurance and wellness benefits to ensure you and your family are well cared for.
Career Trajectory:
We are growing aggressively. For high-performers, the path for advancement moves at the speed of your ambition.

As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you are the implementation owner of a customer’s success with SAFE, from the first onboarding call to a working, trusted deployment delivering value as a key part of their business processes. You sit between the customer's implementation teams and SAFE's engineering teams, understanding all sides well enough to translate between them. You have detailed product knowledge to be able to implement customers' business needs using existing features, and create customisations as needed.

In this role you will have a strong understanding of SAFE/Industry best practice, guiding the customer to achieve their outcomes on the SAFE Platform, This will include educating and enabling the customer, as well as a technical implementation.

You build the scripts, configure the platform, integrations, agents and automations that get a customer live. You diagnose what stands in the way of a customer's success, and where necessary engage internal teams with a clear, evidenced problem statement with an agreed outcome. You hold the end-to-end picture of how SAFE works, so a conversation between a customer and SAFE teams reaches a decision quickly.

You use AI tooling every day to engage with customers more effectively, work with more autonomy and enable others, improving existing processes and tooling to achieve rapid deployments and value realisation.

What you'll do:

Own customer onboarding and delivery

Lead technical onboarding for assigned customers: scope, plan, configure, integrate and confirm the customer is getting value.
Own each engagement to a defined outcome. Keep the customer and internal teams informed on progress, risks and next steps.
Travel to customer sites for workshops, deployments and escalations.
Write scripts and lightweight automations that speed up onboarding, data loading, integration set-up and repeat tasks.

Technical implementation

Collect technical details from customers about their environment, data sources and integrations: authentication, permissions, network constraints, payload formats and expected behaviour.
Configure and customise the SAFE platform to meet customer business needs, making direct product fixes where appropriate.
Build and test customer-specific workflows and AI agents, using SAFE and third-party APIs as needed.
Build custom solutions to achieve customer outcomes where product gaps exist.
Create tooling to accelerate delivery processes and automate repetitive tasks.
Diagnose failed or incomplete integrations and data flows.

Debug and troubleshoot

Reproduce and investigate issues using logs, platform telemetry and platform knowledge. Work methodically from symptom to evidence to cause, with or without AI tooling
Present each issue to engineering with the evidence: what happens, what should happen, who it affects, and what you have already ruled out.
Stay with the issue until the customer has a resolution or an agreed workaround.

Bridge the customer and engineering

Talk to engineering stakeholders as a peer. Define the outcome a customer needs, not the implementation.
Join customer and internal technical calls to provide expert guidance and drive project deliverables to completion.
Spot patterns across customers. Raise them as product feedback with the customer's business outcome and their own words.
Act as an internal customer, working closely with Product teams to ensure that new features are understood and have a clear route to deliver customer value.

Use AI tooling to scale your work

Use AI tools to analyse logs, draft scripts, summarise issues and prepare customer-facing material, using your experience to refine outcomes.
Turn repeated tasks into reusable scripts, AI skills or automations that the wider team can use.

What you'll bring:

Essential

Ownership and accountability. You take a problem as yours until it is closed, and you say so early when something slips.
Creative thinking and problem-solving. You find a route to success, resolving issues as you hit them.
Curiosity. Not everything is documented. You explore, discover and experiment to achieve an outcome.
Experience in script building, product delivery and working directly with customers. This can come from a customer-facing technical role or substantial project work.
Product onboarding experience. You have taken customers or users from set-up to live use of a technical product.
API fluency. You can read API documentation, call and chain endpoints, handle authentication, and interpret responses and errors.
Debugging and troubleshooting skills. You work methodically from symptom to evidence to cause, respecting customer data handling requirements.
Excellent written/verbal communication. You explain technical findings and concepts clearly to the level of the target audience, backed by an expert understanding of the system architecture.
Development. You write scripts that call APIs, process data, and automate customer tasks using Python as a preferred language. You understand code generated by AI tools for human review and challenge.
Cloud Services. You understand core cloud-based services and how they can be implemented at customers and used by SAFE.
Demonstrable use of AI tooling. You can show real examples of using AI to troubleshoot, script or automate, and you can say where it fell short.
Ability to travel to customer sites.

Nice to have

Exposure to cybersecurity, risk management or security-tool integrations (for example, vulnerability scanners, SIEM, asset inventories or identity providers).
Bash or PowerShell.
Experience in a customer-facing technical role (forward deployed, solutions, customer or support engineering) at a SaaS or enterprise software company.
Experience working in distributed, multi-time-zone teams.

Why this role is exciting:

Own customer outcomes at the point where SAFE meets real enterprise environments.
Work with engineering, product and customer teams on problems that shape the platform.
Build creative solutions to problems, both customer facing and internal
Learn cyber risk, Third Party Risk Management (TPRM) and Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM), a growing part of cybersecurity.
Use Python, APIs and AI tooling to remove manual work for yourself and the team.

If you’re passionate about cyber risk, thrive in a fast-paced environment, and want to be part of a team that’s redefining security, we want to hear from you!
🚀

You will act as a trusted team player, guiding others in the team on how to adopt a Product Engineering mindset and be the expert on specific Google Cloud technologies/products.

Key Responsibilities:

Outcome-Driven Design and Build: Actively participate in technical discovery workshops to translate client business requirements into GCP technology design elements and customized solutions. Design, build, test and deploy innovative, agentic-first solutions on GCP that are directly tied to the client business requirements.

Hands-On Development & Proof-of-Value: Rapidly design, build, and present compelling proof-of-concept (POC) solutions that bring your Google Cloud proficiency to workable solutions. This includes hands-on software engineering using Vertex AI, Gemini/Agentic AI, BigQuery, Google Data technologies, Terraform, and modern CI/CD practices.

Product-Led Project delivery: Act as an agile SME/coach on modern software development. Guide and enable the delivery team on the principles of the Product Agile Operating Model and how to structure delivery sprints for continuous delivery using Google Cloud Technologies.

Team Collaboration: Ability to travel as needed for project meetings, workshops, client discussions, etc., Working with global teams and leveraging the various collaborative tools and channels for project delivery and status reporting.

Travel may be required for this role. The amount of travel will vary from 0 to 100% depending on business need and client requirements.

Here's What You Need

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field or equivalent (minimum 12 years) work experience. (If Associate’s Degree, must have minimum 6 years work experience).

Minimum of 3 years of experience in a hands-on, client-facing technology role (e.g., Google Cloud Engineer, Product Engineer, Technology Consultant).

Minimum of 3 years of deep, hands-on experience architecting and building solutions on GCP.

Minimum of 2 years of experience interacting with project team members distributed across the globe. Well versed in project management methodologies and product/project testing methodologies.

Minimum of 2 years of proven experience on Google Cloud technologies OR Minimum of 1 years of implementation experience on EITHER Agentic systems, leveraging Google Gemini Enterprise, Microsoft Azure Foundry, Microsoft Co-Pilot and/or AWS Bedrock OR on Agentic systems and Google Gemini Enterprise Partner Specialist certifications (CPS)

Bonus points if you have

Product & Agile Mindset: Hands-on experience working within a Product Operating Model. Practical experience in delivering agile projects, contributing to sprint-based deliverables and outcomes.

Consulting & Innovation Acumen: Experience participating in client-facing innovation workshops and converting ideas into outcome-focused solutions. World-class communication skills to articulate project status and delivery challenges and issues to project leadership and client audiences.

Agentic AI & Software Product Engineering: Proven experience architecting and building agentic workflows using Vertex AI. Deep understanding of agentic components, including reasoning engines, planning, tool use, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). Hands-on expertise with Google's Gemini models. A commitment to software engineering best practices, including CI/CD, automated testing, and building secure, scalable products.

Technical Depth: Google Cloud Professional certifications (e.g., Professional Cloud Architect, Professional Machine Learning Engineer, Professional Data Engineer, GenAI Leader). Project experience across the GCP ecosystem, including GKE, BigQuery, Vertex AI, CES, Apigee, and other GCP technologies.

Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company, freeing people and agents to ship what's next. For more than a decade we've helped builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience.

Now we're scaling our products for both agents and people to ship and run software, built in the open and trusted by OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide.

About The Role

As a Solutions Architect on the Field Engineering team, you'll be the trusted technical advisor to enterprise customers across pre-sales and post-sales, for teams running AI and web workloads on Vercel. You'll qualify technical fit, design future-state architectures, and run evaluations and proofs of concept before the deal, then guide adoption as lead architect after it, bringing in Professional Services, Developer Success, Product, and Engineering when customers need them. This is a hybrid role based in Austin, New York City, or San Francisco, with three days a week in the office.

What you'll do

Lead technical discovery with Sales, qualify use cases, and design target architectures for AI agents and web applications on Vercel
Own proofs of concept (POCs) and pilots end to end: set success criteria, guide implementation, and document outcomes for executive buyers
Build and deliver tailored demos, technical presentations, and workshops for developer and executive audiences
Act as lead architect post-sale for strategic accounts, guiding onboarding, reference implementations, and migrations, and tuning performance with Core Web Vitals and observability data
Run customer security, compliance, and architecture reviews, and feed recurring field gaps back to Product and Engineering

What you need

5+ years of experience in a customer-facing technical role such as solutions architect, sales engineer, or platform architect, working with web or cloud platforms
Hands-on JavaScript and TypeScript experience, including reviewing production application code built with Next.js, React, or another modern framework
Designed enterprise architectures covering web performance, caching, networking, and security on AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
Ran technical evaluations or POCs on enterprise deals with both executive and developer stakeholders

Bonus if you

Built and shipped an AI-powered application or agent, for example with the AI SDK
Led a large-scale migration to a cloud-native or composable architecture (headless CMS, commerce, identity)
Supported customer security reviews against SOC 2, PCI DSS, or HIPAA

Competitive compensation package, including equity.
Inclusive Healthcare Package.
Learn and Grow - we provide mentorship and send you to events that help you build your network and skills.
Flexible Time Off.

added.title: Partner Solutions Architect
added.description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is The Role:

Are you looking to kickstart or grow your career in technical presales and make a meaningful impact on the growth of our partner ecosystem?

As a Partner Solutions Architect
, you will help scale Elastic’s technical reach by enabling and supporting a defined set of partners (resellers, systems integrators, MSSPs, and cloud providers). Working under established standards and in collaboration with senior SAs and Partner Managers, you will help build partner confidence so they can effectively position, demonstrate, and deliver Elastic solutions.

This role focuses on three core pillars:

Supporting partner deal enablement and intake
Delivering foundational technical enablement and labs
Assisting in the rollout and demonstration of standard solutions

You will work within an assigned partner territory following defined technical engagement plans. This is a collaborative, sales-aligned position with moderate scope where success is measured on execution accuracy, timely completion of tactical milestones, and enablement delivery. Candidates should plan for up to 30–40% travel in support of partner events, lab days, and training sessions.

What You Will Be Doing:

Support Growth With and Through Partners

Review and help process partner deal registrations alongside Partner Managers, ensuring technical intake requirements and scoping criteria are met.
Execute partner sales playbooks on qualified opportunities, helping partners understand how Elastic solutions and their own services fit together.
Support hands-on labs, standard demonstrations, and basic Proofs of Concept (PoCs) in collaboration with account AEs and senior Solutions Architects.
Keep up to date on core Elastic product features and competitive positioning to help partners articulate "Why Elastic" accurately.

Enable Partner Leverage & Technical Readiness

Build productive working relationships with partner technical staff, acting as a responsive, front-line technical contact for assigned partners.
Contribute to and execute tactical milestones within partner Technical Engagement Plans under the direction of senior team members.
Deliver foundational technical workshops, product overviews, and hands-on lab sessions that guide partner engineers toward accreditation and certification.
Help partners navigate Elastic enablement tracks, standard demonstration assets, and learning paths.

Assist with Standard Solutions & Assets

Assist partners with the deployment and setup of standard Elastic demonstration environments, sandbox labs, and testing grounds.
Deliver approved demos and presentation decks (Google Slides, Zoom, whiteboarding) to partner teams.
Help gather feedback, partner requirements, and technical questions from the field to share back with internal Elastic teams.
Contribute to reusable collateral—such as demo walkthroughs, configuration checklists, and FAQ notes—using established templates and best practices.

What You Bring:

Education & Experience: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience; 0–2 years of experience in technical presales, solutions engineering, consulting, or technical support.
Core Technical Knowledge: Foundational understanding of at least one core domain: Search/AI concepts, Security Operations (SIEM/Endpoint), or Observability/Cloud infrastructure.
Cloud & Tools Familiarity: Basic hands-on familiarity with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and common system environments.
Communication & Presentation: Solid verbal and written communication skills with the ability to clearly explain technical concepts, ask clarifying questions, and deliver engaging product presentations.
Execution & Coachability: High attention to detail, strong organizational habits, and an eagerness to take constructive feedback from senior team members and quickly apply it to assignments.
Teamwork & Professionalism: Ability to build stable internal and external relationships, complete assigned tasks within defined timelines, and exercise sound judgment using standard operating procedures.
Travel: Willingness and ability to travel up to 40% for partner visits, workshops, and enablement events.

Bonus Points:

Hands-on scripting knowledge (Python, Bash, or JSON) for data ingestion, automation, or demo setup.
Prior experience delivering technical tutoring, lab assistance, or software training.
Baseline familiarity with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) or search technologies.
Target or progress toward achieving the Elastic Certified Engineer (ECE) certification and a foundational Cloud Service Provider (CSP) certification within your first year.

Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People:

As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.

We strive to have parity of benefits across regions, and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.

Competitive pay based on the work you do here and not your previous salary
Health coverage for you and your family in many locations
Ability to craft your calendar with flexible locations and schedules for many roles
Generous number of vacation days each year
Increase your impact - We match up to $2000 (or local currency equivalent) for financial donations and service
Up to 40 hours each year to use toward volunteer projects you love
Embracing parenthood with a minimum of 16 weeks of parental leave

Forward Deployed Engineer)

Infrastructure Solutions Group (ISG)
builds the products that power infrastructure, solutions, and data management our customers need most. Our teams design and develop the hardware and software that connect infrastructure, accelerate computational workloads, integrate across the stack, protect data continuity, and deliver the platforms, applications, and diagnostics our customers rely on every day at enterprise scale.

Some product builders follow the rules. Ours rewrite them.

Engineers define intent, author precise specifications, and orchestrate AI agents that execute at speed and scale. AI is embedded throughout our development process, helping us move faster, learn quicker, and deliver greater impact. Yet the most important contribution remains uniquely human: deciding what to build, designing how it should work, and applying the judgment needed to earn our customers' trust. When your products power critical infrastructure around the world, that responsibility matters.
We move quickly toward the work that matters most. We reward experimentation, encourage bold thinking, and remove unnecessary barriers so great ideas can become reality faster. Our teams embrace a customer-first, first-to-market mindset, transforming rapid feedback into better products and better outcomes. We aren't looking for people who are content with the status quo- we look for builders who question it, improve it, and occasionally rewrite it.

If you're energized by solving complex systems challenges, excited to work alongside AI to amplify your impact, and motivated by the opportunity to shape what's next instead of simply maintaining what's been done before, you'll find your place here.

Join us and help build the future of enterprise technology,
to do the best work of your career and make a profound social impact as an Agent Ops, Technical Product Management
on our Servers Agent Ops builds
team
in Round Rock, Texas
.

, you will work directly with product, engineering, and operations teams to understand their problems, identify the patterns behind them, and define and curate agent-based solutions. You'll combine a product mindset (discover and define) with a working technical foundation (code, data, and modern AI tooling), as part of a small team led by a senior technical lead.

Work with server teams to understand workflows and pain points and turn them into well-defined problems

Define, curate, and prioritize agentic solutions, including requirements, success measures, and data and tool integrations
Prototype and contribute to solutions using code and integrations, including MCP tools

Take the first step towards your dream career

Experience spanning full-stack development, AI/agent technologies (including MCP), AI-assisted software development, customer-facing technical and product roles, and enterprise infrastructure, hardware, and software solutions

added.title: Advisory Services Consultant, Consultant Development Program - AI/ML Engineering Track - Multiple Locations
added.description:
Internships at Optum.
If you want an intern experience that will dramatically shape your career, consider a company that's dramatically shaping our entire health care system. Optum, part of the UnitedHealth Group family of companies, is a leading health services and innovation company dedicated to helping make the health system work better for everyone. With more than 94,000 people collaborating worldwide, Optum combines people, technology, data and action to improve the delivery, quality and efficiency of health care. Our internship opportunities provide a view of a rapidly evolving, incredibly challenging marketplace of ideas, products and services. Here, you'll work with some of the smartest people in the business on assignments that matter. Join us in making healthcare work better for everyone through people-led, responsible AI while Caring. Connecting. Growing together

Begin your career at UnitedHealth Group and help make health care work better for everyone. Through our Early Careers programs, you'll gain meaningful experience, tackle real business challenges, and contribute to work that impacts millions of lives.

Across UnitedHealthcare and Optum, we're united by a common purpose: improving the health and well-being of the people and communities we serve. You'll work alongside talented colleagues, develop new skills, and be supported by a culture of innovation, inclusion, and continuous learning.

No matter where your journey starts, you'll have the opportunity to grow, make an impact, and help shape the future of health care.

The full-time position located in Eden Prairie, MN, Nashville, TN or Washington, DC will be available starting in 2027**
UnitedHealth Group is not able to offer visa sponsorship now or in the future for position**
Relocation is not offered for the Consultant Development Program**

The Consultant Development Program (CDP) is an Early Careers program that launches early-careers professionals into real consulting work, solving problems and shaping outcomes for health care clients from day one. CDP sits within Optum Advisory, giving participants the chance to work with a diverse range of health care clients across multiple engagements. As a CDP participant, you'll join a cohort spanning multiple tracks, all united by a shared focus on serving our clients and making the health system work better for everyone. You'll complete structured consulting and healthcare training, receive mentorship from experienced leaders, and gain experience across multiple client engagements while developing capabilities in strategic problem solving, data-driven decision making, client relationship management, change management, AI-enabled consulting, and healthcare industry expertise. Program completion includes alignment into an Optum Advisory practice and typically takes 1.5-2.5 years to complete. By combining real client delivery, structured learning, mentorship, healthcare industry specialization, and AI-enabled consulting experiences from day one, CDP provides a differentiated foundation for a long-term consulting career. The AI/ML Engineering track pairs this core consulting foundation with hands-on exposure to building the AI/ML solutions - LLM applications, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, and early agentic AI workflows - that increasingly power client engagements, working alongside Optum.ai engineering and data science teams.

Primary Responsibilities

Working directly with our internal and external clients to solve complex business problems by performing the following types of activities:
Enable strategic business transformation through the application of technology, AI, process improvement and innovation to our client's most complex problems
Apply and integrate AI tools into client workflows - research, analysis, reporting, dashboards, and automation - building and optimizing prompts along the way
Lead selected client-facing interactions and presentations, communicate technical recommendations and trade-offs, and build client relationships during project delivery
Own defined AI/ML workstreams, including requirements analysis, solution development, evaluation, and communication of results
Develop and fine-tune LLM-based applications for client and internal use cases, including prompt engineering and API integration with commercial and open-source models (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic/Claude, Gemini)
Design and implement retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines and agentic AI workflows - including document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector search, tool-use, reasoning, and planning patterns - for defined client use cases
Test, evaluate, and refine AI/ML solutions for accuracy, safety, and performance, including hallucination detection, bias monitoring, and human-in-the-loop evaluation
Prepare solutions for production by applying testing, CI/CD, and monitoring practices, and support a clear transition to Optum or client production engineering teams
Apply responsible-AI and healthcare data considerations (PHI/PII protection, privacy and regulatory requirements, governance guardrails) throughout AI/ML solution development
Partner with Optum.ai engineering, data science, and product teams to translate client business requirements into technical AI/ML solution components, and communicate progress, risks, and trade-offs to client and internal stakeholders

Optum Advisory provides consulting support to a wide range of health care clients. Some example projects might include:
Building a go-to-market strategy and business case to bring a new product or service to market by providing an opportunity analysis derived through complex data navigation
Designing an AI adoption roadmap to help a health system responsibly scale AI-enabled clinical and administrative tools across the organization
Designing and building a RAG-based knowledge assistant for a health system's clinical documentation workflows, from data ingestion through evaluation
Fine-tuning and integrating an LLM-powered prior authorization assistant for a payer client, including prompt design and evaluation against real case outcomes
Designing an agentic workflow that automates intake and triage for a provider's call center, including tool-use, planning, escalation logic, and human-in-the-loop controls

What You'll Do

Apply AI tools to solve business problems within your domain
Build and optimize prompts for analysis, reporting, and automation
Integrate AI into workflows (e.g., reporting, dashboards, operations processes)
Analyze data using AI-enabled tools and generate insights
Collaborate with teams to identify opportunities for AI-driven improvements
Ensure responsible and compliant use of AI solutions

You'll be rewarded and recognized for your performance in an environment that will challenge you and give you clear direction on what it takes to succeed in your role as well as provide development for other roles you may be interested in.

Required Qualifications

2+ years of experience through graduate research, internships, fellowships, postdoctoral work, or professional roles in ML, AI engineering, or applied data science
2+ years of experience developing Python-based ML/AI solutions
1+ years of experience building Generative AI or LLM applications
Experience taking an ML/AI project from problem definition through development and evaluation
Experience using AI-assisted development ("vibe coding") tools such as Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, or similar
Ability to work in office on a hybrid schedule (3 days in office) in one of our 3 locations (Eden Prairie, MN, Nashville, TN or Washington D.C.) for the duration of the program
Ability to Travel up to 50% for the Consultant Development Program, dependent on project needs and location
Must be eligible to work in the U.S. without company sponsorship, now or in the future, for employment-based work authorization (F-1 students with practical training and candidates requiring H-1Bs, TNs, etc. will not be considered) F-1 visa holders with Optional Practical Training (OPT) who will require H-1B status, TNs, or current H-1B visa holders will not be considered. H1-B and green card sponsorship is not available for this position

Preferred Qualifications

3.0 GPA
1+ year of experience with RAG, vector search, or similar retrieval-based AI approaches
Healthcare Experience
Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, or Semantic Kernel
Experience building or contributing to agentic AI systems, including tool-calling, planning frameworks, or multi-agent workflows
Experience optimizing LLM latency, cost, and performance in production environments
Experience deploying AI systems on cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP
Experience working in regulated environments with responsible AI governance requirements
Proven intellectual Curiosity

Pay is based on several factors including but not limited to local labor markets, education, work experience, certifications, etc. In addition to your salary, we offer benefits such as, a comprehensive benefits package, incentive and recognition programs, equity stock purchase and 401k contribution (all benefits are subject to eligibility requirements). No matter where or when you begin a career with us, you'll find a far-reaching choice of benefits and incentives. The salary for this role will range from $72,800 - $130,000 annually based on full-time employment. We comply with all minimum wage laws as applicable.

At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and help make the health system work better for everyone. Together, we are shaping the future of healthcare by harnessing technology and innovation to make care simpler to navigate, more affordable and more connected for the people we serve. Strong knowledge of network architecture, database programming (SQL/NoSQL), and data modeling.
Familiarity with cloud data services, big data processing tools, and Linux env

added.title: Senior Software Engineer, AI Data
added.description:
NVIDIA is a pioneer in accelerated computing, known for inventing the GPU and driving breakthroughs in gaming, computer graphics, high-performance computing, and artificial intelligence. Our technology powers everything from generative AI to autonomous systems, and we continue to shape the future of computing through innovation and collaboration. Within this mission, our team, Managed AI Research Superclusters (MARS), builds and scales the infrastructure, platforms, and tools that enable researchers and engineers to develop the next generation of AI/ML systems. By joining us, you'll help build solutions that power some of the planet's most advanced computing workloads.

The MARS AI Data team owns how NVIDIA's AI research uses data: many petabytes of training data, checkpoints and datasets across multiple clouds and partners. We build the layer between storage and the workload. That covers data placement across file systems, object storage, and local NVMe. It also includes streaming loaders and caches that supply tens of thousands of GPU cores. Efficient checkpoint management. Quotas remain fair throughout numerous research groups. This is a builder's role on a team that is redefining what it does. You will help design MARS' data platform on Kubernetes from the ground up, working directly with the researchers training NVIDIA's own models. The work shows up as faster training steps, shorter restarts and fewer runs lost to complete storage volumes.

What You'll Be Doing

Design and build the AI data layer for a multi-cloud GPU fleet: how datasets, checkpoints and scratch data are placed, cached, tiered and moved between different storage backends.
Build high-throughput data paths for training and RL. That means streaming loaders from object storage, distributed caches, and checkpoint save and restore at thousands of GPUs, including peer-to-peer and local-first restore.
Make data a first-class part of the compute platform. Build Kubernetes-native APIs, operators and storage integrations so a job declares the data it needs, and the platform mounts, caches and accounts for it, on Slurm and on Kubernetes.
Own quotas, capacity and data lifecycle across hundreds of research teams: usage attribution, quota enforcement, retention, clean-up of stale data, and forecasting capacity before it runs out.
Measure how workloads use data. Build I/O telemetry and access analytics that show hot and cold data, metadata pressure and I/O stalls, and use them to drive placement and fixes.
Own reliability for what you build: on-call, incident analysis, and changes that stop whole classes of data incidents, such as full file systems, runaway metadata load and lost checkpoints.

What We Need To See

BS or MS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience.
5+ years building production systems or data-infrastructure software.
Deep experience with at least one of the following: parallel or distributed file systems (Lustre, WEKA, VAST, GPFS, Ceph or similar), object storage at scale (S3 or compatible), or large-scale data pipelines and data lakes.
A clear grasp of I/O performance: throughput, latency, metadata cost, caching and how access patterns interact with each.
Strong programming in Go, Rust, C or C++, plus Python for tooling and analysis.
A track record of owning a service in production and making it measurably better.
Clear written and spoken communication with engineers and researchers.

Ways to stand out from the crowd

Experience feeding large-scale AI training: data loaders, streaming datasets, and storage behavior at thousands of GPUs.
Experience with checkpointing at scale: asynchronous or distributed checkpoints, tiered checkpoint storage, fast restart after failure.
Built or ran a distributed cache or AI-oriented storage system, or used node-local NVMe as a managed tier.
Built a quota, accounting or capacity system that many teams depended on.
Knowledge of RL and agentic workloads and what they need from storage: many small reads, environment snapshots, sandbox images and fast fan-out.

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and other objective job-related factors. The expected base salary ranges for this position are:

152,000 USD – 241,500 USD for Level 3; and 184,000 USD – 287,500 USD for Level 4.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until November 13, 2026.

Design and build the AI data layer for a multi-cloud GPU fleet: how datasets, checkpoints and scratch data are placed, cached, tiered and moved between different storage backends.
Build high-throughput data paths for training and RL. That means streaming loaders from object storage, distributed caches, and checkpoint save and restore at thousands of GPUs, including peer-to-peer and local-first restore.
Make data a first-class part of the compute platform. Build Kubernetes-native APIs, operators and storage integrations so a job declares the data it needs, and the platform mounts, caches and accounts for it, on Slurm and on Kubernetes.
Own quotas, capacity and data lifecycle across hundreds of research teams: usage attribution, quota enforcement, retention, clean-up of stale data, and forecasting capacity before it runs out.
Measure how workloads use data. Build I/O telemetry and access analytics that show hot and cold data, metadata pressure and I/O stalls, and use them to drive placement and fixes.
Own reliability for what you build: on-call, incident analysis, and changes that stop whole classes of data incidents, such as full file systems, runaway metadata load and lost checkpoints.

What We Need To See

BS or MS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience.
5+ years building production systems or data-infrastructure software.
Deep experience with at least one of the following: parallel or distributed file systems (Lustre, WEKA, VAST, GPFS, Ceph or similar), object storage at scale (S3 or compatible), or large-scale data pipelines and data lakes.
A clear grasp of I/O performance: throughput, latency, metadata cost, caching and how access patterns interact with each.
Strong programming in Go, Rust, C or C++, plus Python for tooling and analysis.
A track record of owning a service in production and making it measurably better.
Clear written and spoken communication with engineers and researchers.

Ways to stand out from the crowd

Experience feeding large-scale AI training: data loaders, streaming datasets, and storage behavior at thousands of GPUs.
Experience with checkpointing at scale: asynchronous or distributed checkpoints, tiered checkpoint storage, fast restart after failure.
Built or ran a distributed cache or AI-oriented storage system, or used node-local NVMe as a managed tier.
Built a quota, accounting or capacity system that many teams depended on.
Knowledge of RL and agentic workloads and what they need from storage: many small reads, environment snapshots, sandbox images and fast fan-out.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

added.title: Applied AI Site Reliability Engineer III
added.description:
As an Applied AI Site Reliability Engineer III , you will actively engage in your engineering craft, taking a hands-on approach to the reliability, performance, and operational integrity of high-visibility products and platforms and the environments they run in. Your expertise will be pivotal in keeping production safe, performant, and cost-effective, while driving tangible value for Deloitte's engineering investments. You will leverage your extensive engineering craftsmanship across cloud platform engineering, observability, and performance and reliability engineering-together with applied AI fluency that lets you reliably operate AI and agentic workloads alongside the rest of the portfolio-consistently demonstrating your strong track record in operating high-quality, resilient systems at scale. The ideal candidate will be a dependable team player, collaborating with cross-functional teams to uphold production standards, safeguard environments, and admit systems into production with confidence.

Work You'll Do:

Outcome-Driven Accountability: Embrace and drive a culture of accountability for reliability, performance, and cost outcomes, measured in service-level objectives and error budgets, not raw uptime. Operate the products, platforms, and environments you support to meet their SLOs within budget, and track incident trends and toil to prioritize the work that most improves reliability-ensuring high-quality, lean operational designs that keep production safe and resilient.
Technical Leadership and Advocacy: Serve as the technical advocate for production reliability and operability, ensuring systems are admissible, performant, safe to run, and able to degrade gracefully when failure occurs. Uphold production standards, lead the design of observability, performance and resilience testing, and operational tooling, and own the admission of systems into production-gating release on error budgets and automated reliability checks, and owning the readiness verification, environment integrity, and operational support that follow.
Engineering Craftsmanship: Maintain accountability for the operational integrity of production and pre-production environments, and for the production standards that systems are admitted against. Own SLOs and error budgets; build and operate production observability-codified, version-controlled dashboards and SLO-driven, actionable alerting that detects before impact, plus the feedback loop into engineering; run performance, ambient-noise, and chaos testing to verify readiness; and guard environments against drift. Stay hands-on, self-driven, and continuously learn new approaches, languages, and frameworks-operating as an infrastructure-focused engineer, not a tool operator. Create technical specifications, runbooks, and shared playbooks; lead blameless postmortems that turn incidents into learning and systemic fixes; write high-quality, supportable automation to ensure all reliability KPIs (availability, performance, and cost) are met or exceeded. Demonstrate collaborative skills to work effectively with diverse teams.
Customer-Centric Engineering: Develop lean operational solutions through rapid, inexpensive experimentation to meet the reliability needs of the engineering teams and the business. Engage with those teams before, during, and after delivery, co-defining service-level objectives and operational readiness so the right safeguards are in place at the right time, without becoming a bottleneck to delivery.
Incremental and Iterative Delivery: Adopt a mindset that favors action and evidence over extensive planning. Utilize a leaning-forward approach to navigate complexity and uncertainty, hardening reliability through incremental, measurable improvements-progressive resilience testing and SLO refinement-rather than big-bang interventions, and keeping operations supportable and maintainable.
Cross-Functional Collaboration and Integration: Work collaboratively with empowered, cross-functional partners: engineering, platform engineering, security and risk, data governance, and engineering leadership and architecture. Uphold production standards and integrate their constraints so that the reliable, performant, and compliant path is the operative path. Co-define service-level objectives with the teams you support, verify readiness, and own the admission decision into production-holding the segregation-of-duties line as a dedicated, embedded function while partnering with security and risk on the control objectives you enforce. Foster a collaborative environment that enhances team synergy and innovation.
Advanced Technical Proficiency: Possess expertise in site reliability and modern production engineering-cloud platform ownership, observability (metrics, tracing, logging), performance and capacity engineering, chaos engineering, and cloud/AI cost engineering-together with applied AI fluency to operate AI and agentic workloads reliably, including AI and Agentic SSDLC, delivering production operations with full automation from discovery to production to operations and all quality checks through the SSDLC lifecycle. Strive to be a role model, leveraging these techniques to optimize reliability, performance, and operational delivery. Demonstrate strong understanding of the full lifecycle of platform and product development, focusing on continuous improvement and learning.
Domain Expertise: Quickly acquire domain knowledge of the products and platforms you operate-and, where they are AI-infused, their distinct production failure modes such as drift, train/serve skew, latency and output variance, and token/GPU cost anomalies. Translate reliability needs, reference architectures, and operational requirements into service-level objectives, runbooks, and production tooling. Be a valuable, flexible, and dedicated team member, supportive of teammates, and focused on quality and tech debt payoff.
Effective Communication and Influence: Exhibit exceptional communication skills, capable of articulating complex technical concepts clearly and compellingly. Inspire and influence teammates and product teams through well-structured arguments and trade-offs supported by evidence. Create coherent narratives that align technical solutions with business objectives.
Engagement and Collaborative Co-Creation: Engage and collaborate with product engineering teams at all organizational levels, including customers as needed. Build and maintain constructive relationships, fostering a culture of co-creation and shared momentum towards achieving product goals. Align diverse perspectives and drive consensus to create feasible solutions.

The team:
US Deloitte Technology Product Engineering has modernized software and product delivery, creating a scalable, cost-effective model that focuses on value/outcomes that leverages a progressive and responsive talent structure. As Deloitte's primary internal development team, Product Engineering delivers innovative digital solutions to businesses, service lines, and internal operations with proven bottom-line results and outcomes. It helps power Deloitte's success. It is the engine that drives Deloitte, serving many of the world's largest, most respected companies. We develop and deploy cutting-edge internal and go-to-market solutions that help Deloitte operate effectively and lead in the market. Our reputation is built on a tradition of delivering with excellence.

The successful candidate will possess:

Excellent interpersonal and organizational skills, with the ability to handle diverse situations, complex projects, and changing priorities, behaving with passion, empathy, and care.

Qualifications

Required:

A bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, data science, machine learning, or related discipline. Experience is the most relevant factor.
5+ years of software engineering and site reliability engineering experience operating large-scale, distributed, cloud-native systems in production, with experience in most of the following: Python, Go, Bash, Java, C#/.NET, SQL/NoSQL, Kubernetes, Terraform, ArgoCD, as well as CI/CD and observability stacks.
3+ years of experience in site reliability or production engineering for large-scale systems-defining and owning SLIs, SLOs, and SLAs; error budgets; incident command and on-call; building and operating production observability (metrics, tracing, logging-e.g., OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, Dynatrace, Amazon CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, Google Cloud Operations, SolarWinds, Splunk); environment integrity and drift prevention across pre-production and production; and segregation-of-duties controls (least-privilege/RBAC, deploy approvals, secrets management) in partnership with security and risk.
3+ years of experience with cloud-native engineering and cloud platform ownership on any of the cloud hyperscalers such as Azure, AWS, or GCP-including their AI/ML services such as Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, or Vertex AI-plus container orchestration (Kubernetes, Docker), infrastructure-as-code, networking, and multi-environment management.
Prior experience operating AI/ML and agentic workloads in production-their reliability failure modes (drift, train/serve skew, output variance), MLOps/LLMOps, and the AI control plane (model/LLM gateway, guardrails) from the operability and performance side.
Prior experience with load and performance testing under simulated production traffic (e.g., LoadRunner, k6, or JMeter), chaos engineering (e.g., Azure Chaos Studio, AWS Fault Injector), capacity planning, autoscaling, and cloud/AI cost engineering (FinOps tooling/dashboards, including GPU/inference and token cost attribution).
Prior software engineering experience with the understanding of Business Context Diagrams (BCD), sequence/activity/state/entity relationship/data flow diagrams, OOP/OOD, data structures, algorithms, and code instrumentations, and AI-augmented spec-driven development.
Prior experience using methodologies & tools such as XP, Lean, DevSecOps, SRE, ADO, GitHub, SonarQube, MLflow, and agentic AI frameworks (e.g. LangFuse, LangSmith, or equivalent multi-agent orchestration tools) etc. to operate high-quality, resilient platforms and products at scale.
Ability to travel 10%, on average, based on the work you do and products you build.
Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.
Candidates must be located within a commutable distance to the select location available for this role.
Ability to work in your local office at a minimum of 3 days per week

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

added.description:
We are:

A leading partner to the world’s major cloud providers, including AWS, Azure, and Google. The formation of Accenture Cloud First, with a $3 billion investment over three years, demonstrates our commitment to deliver greater value to our clients when they need it most and offers huge growth opportunities for you! Our Cloud First group of more than 70,000 cloud professionals delivers a full stack of integrated cloud capabilities across data, edge, integrated infrastructure and applications, deep ecosystem skills, culture of change along with a deep industry expertise to shape, move, build and operate our clients’ businesses in the cloud. To accelerate our customers transformation leveraging cloud, we combine world-class learning and talent development expertise; deep experience in cloud change management; and cloud-ready operating models with a commitment to responsible business by design — with security, data privacy, responsible use of artificial intelligence, sustainability and ethics and compliance built into the fundamental changes Accenture helps companies achieve.

About the Role: Building the Future in the Age of Agents

Join the elite technical and product engine of the Accenture Google Business Group (AGBG). We are not a traditional project delivery organization; we are a practice of innovators and builders guiding our clients through the most significant shift in technology: the move to Agentic AI and Product-Led Operating Models. As a Google Cloud Platform (GCP) Agentic AI Delivery Senior Engineer, you are a new breed of technologist—a "product-minded engineer" who is as fluent in the language of code as you are in the language of customer outcomes. You don't just build solutions; you leverage the best of technologies Google Cloud has to offer for client requirements, helping clients break free from legacy solution mindset and practices to build truly modern, value-driven software products on Google Cloud.

You Are:

A passionate, hands-on GCP Senior Engineer who understands that great software is not just about elegant code, but about solving real problems leveraging the best technology tools available for a client. You are as comfortable building a multi-agent workflow on Vertex AI as you are testing a solution built by other team members in a compressed timeline, leveraging the various tools and technologies of Google Cloud. You have a consultative mindset and a deep curiosity to understand the "why" behind a client's business requirements and convert them to an optimal technology solution. You are an evangelist for modern ways of working, grounded in the principles of Product-Led engineering and operating models and related approaches. You are an exceptional communicator, great team player, continuous learner and a true believer in continual change.

The Work:

As a GCP Agentic AI Delivery Senior Engineer, you will be a technical and product-centric engineer in consulting and engineering projects, customizing Google Cloud Agentic solutions for client requirements. You will partner with Accenture's global delivery teams by providing superior technical expertise and product innovation skills. Your role is to execute complex technology solutions for our clients by designing, building, and demonstrating Agentic AI solutions. You will act as a trusted team player, guiding others in the team on how to adopt a Product Engineering mindset and be the expert on specific Google Cloud technologies/products.

Key Responsibilities:

Outcome-Driven Design and Build: Actively participate in technical discovery workshops to translate client business requirements into GCP technology design elements and customized solutions. Design, build, test and deploy innovative, agentic-first solutions on GCP that are directly tied to the client business requirements.

Hands-On Development & Proof-of-Value: Rapidly design, build, and present compelling proof-of-concept (POC) solutions that bring your Google Cloud proficiency to workable solutions. This includes hands-on software engineering using Vertex AI, Gemini/Agentic AI, BigQuery, Google Data technologies, Terraform, and modern CI/CD practices.

Product-Led Project delivery: Act as an agile SME/coach on modern software development. Guide and enable the delivery team on the principles of the Product Agile Operating Model and how to structure delivery sprints for continuous delivery using Google Cloud Technologies.

Team Collaboration: Ability to travel as needed for project meetings, workshops, client discussions, etc., Working with global teams and leveraging the various collaborative tools and channels for project delivery and status reporting.

Travel may be required for this role. The amount of travel will vary from 0 to 100% depending on business need and client requirements

Here's What You Need

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field or equivalent (minimum 12 years) work experience. (If Associate’s Degree, must have minimum 6 years work experience).Minimum of 5 years of experience in a hands-on, client-facing technology role (e.g., Google Cloud Engineer, Product Engineer, Technology Consultant).

Minimum of 5 years of deep, hands-on experience architecting and building solutions on AWS/Azure/GCP, of which 4 years in GCP.

Minimum of 3 years of experience interacting with project team members distributed across the globe. Well versed in project management methodologies and product/project testing methodologies.

Minimum of 3 years of proven experience on Google Cloud technologies OR Minimum of 1 year of implementation experience on EITHER Agentic systems, leveraging Google Gemini Enterprise, Microsoft Azure Foundry, Microsoft Co-Pilot and/or AWS Bedrock OR implementation experience on Agentic systems and Google Gemini Enterprise Partner Specialist certifications (CPS)

Bonus points if you have

Product & Agile Mindset: Hands-on experience working within a Product Operating Model. Practical experience in delivering agile projects, contributing to sprint based deliverables and outcomes.

Consulting & Innovation Acumen: Experience participating in client-facing innovation workshops and converting ideas into outcome-focused solutions. World-class communication skills to articulate project status and delivery challenges and issues to project leadership and client audiences.

Agentic AI & Software Product Engineering: Proven experience architecting and building agentic workflows using Vertex AI. Deep understanding of agentic components, including reasoning engines, planning, tool use, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). Hands-on expertise with Google's Gemini models. A commitment to software engineering best practices, including CI/CD, automated testing, and building secure, scalable products.

Technical Depth: Multiple Google Cloud Professional certifications (e.g., Professional Cloud Architect, Professional Machine Learning Engineer, Professional Data Engineer, GenAI Leader). Project experience across the GCP ecosystem, including GKE, BigQuery, Vertex AI, CES, Apigee, and other GCP technologies.

added.title: Senior Software Engineer - Internal AI Agent Infrastructure
added.description:
At Qualtrics, we create software the world’s best brands use to deliver exceptional frontline experiences, build high-performing teams, and design products people love. But we are more than a platform—we are the creators and stewards of the Experience Management category serving over thousands of clients globally. Building a category takes grit, determination, and a disdain for convention—but most of all it requires close-knit, high-functioning teams with an unwavering dedication to serving our customers.

When you join one of our teams, you’ll be part of a nimble group that’s empowered to set aggressive goals and move fast to achieve them. Strategic risks are encouraged and complex problems are solved together, by passing the mic and iterating until the best solution comes to light. You won’t have to look to find growth opportunities—ready or not, they’ll find you. From retail to government to healthcare, we’re on a mission to bring humanity, connection, and empathy back to business. Join over 5,000 people across the globe who think that’s work worth doing.

Senior Software Engineer - Internal AI Agent Infrastructure

Why We Have This Role The Internal AI Agent Infrastructure team builds an internal cloud agent platform that helps Qualtrics engineers use AI agents running on company infrastructure. This role will contribute to the platform, including a near-term effort to support Press Ganey users with a different GitLab instance. The work also includes the MCP gateway, which connects approved tools and services for internal use. The platform helps engineers use AI capabilities while the team manages security and governance requirements. The role works with a senior engineering team and responds to feedback from engineers across Qualtrics.

How You'll Find Success

Take initiative, be a self-starter, and propose ideas to move the team forward.
Follow the latest industry trend changes in AI tooling and research how they could be applied to the platform.
Possessing deep knowledge of agent concepts such as MCPs, skills, harnesses, and more.
Advocate for changes that can improve platform usage, speed, or reliability.
Use feedback from engineers to help shape platform work.
Take responsibility for features through release and follow-up bug fixes.

How You'll Grow

Develop experience building and maintaining an internal cloud agent platform.
Learn about AI tools and developments by evaluating how they can be used at Qualtrics.
Understand how to build and maintain security controls and provide AI governance to an enterprise.
Hone your product management skills by learning the needs of our engineers to build out roadmaps boosting their productivity.

Things You'll Do

Improve the platform by designing and implementing new features based on engineering needs and feedback.
Expand access to the platform by supporting new GitLab instances and other repositories.
Enable internal tool use by managing and governing our MCP Gateway which controls all MCP integrations.
Partner with our security team to ensure all new toolings are compliant and adequate admin controls are in place.
Proactively improve platform use and reliability by identifying bottlenecks and making changes to address them.
Own delivered features through release and address bugs and technical debt that arise.

What We're Looking For On Your Resume

Experience improving developer experience (DevEx), such as building, buying, or integrating tools for internal engineering teams.
Hands-on expertise with modern AI tooling, including MCP servers, agent skills, agent harnesses, and using AI agents in your daily workflow.
A track record of designing and building platforms that scale, along with reliable, maintainable systems and processes.
Experience partnering directly with internal users to gather feedback, measure adoption, and turn pain points into product improvements.
Strong ownership and communication skills, including driving cross-team initiatives, writing clear technical documentation, and helping other engineers adopt new tools and practices.
Machine learning experience is a plus, not a requirement.
5+ years of software development experience.

What You Should Know About This Team

The team has 6 people, all at senior level or above, and has an on-call rotation.
Work is mostly focused coding, with a daily standup and usually about one weekly team discussion or design review.
The team moves fast; we have at least one notable change each week that impacts all of engineering.
The team uses feedback from engineers to guide platform improvements.
The team's work includes reviewing new AI developments and considering how to make them usable by other engineers.

Our Team's Favorite Perks And Benefits

Fun and collaborative office environment with in office amenities, food, drinks, outdoor space, and of course, pinball!
Quarterly team offsites, giving developers a chance to interact with each other outside of the office and build camaraderie.
Education budget you can flexibly spend on topics that interest you.
QED (Qualtrics Engineer Development) Program encourages all engineers to invest in themselves up to 10% of their time each quarter to advance their careers.

The Qualtrics Hybrid Work Model:
Our hybrid work model is elegantly simple: we all gather in the office three days a week; Mondays and Thursdays, plus one day selected by your organizational leader. These purposeful in-person days in thoughtfully designed offices help us do our best work and harness the power of collaboration and innovation. For the rest of the week, work where you want, owning the integration of work and life.

Engage with those teams before, during, and after delivery, co-defining service-level objectives and operational readiness so the right safeguards are in place at the right time, without becoming a bottleneck to delivery.
Incremental and Iterative Delivery: Adopt a mindset that favors action and evidence over extensive planning. Utilize a leaning-forward approach to navigate complexity and uncertainty, hardening reliability through incremental, measurable improvements-progressive resilience testing and SLO refinement-rather than big-bang interventions, and keeping operations supportable and maintainable.
Cross-Functional Collaboration and Integration: Work collaboratively with empowered, cross-functional partners: engineering, platform engineering, security and risk, data governance, and engineering leadership and architecture. Set production standards and integrate their constraints so that the reliable, performant, and compliant path is the operative path. Co-define service-level objectives with the teams you support, verify readiness, and own the admission decision into production-holding the segregation-of-duties line as a dedicated, embedded function while partnering with security and risk on the control objectives you enforce. Foster a collaborative environment that enhances team synergy and innovation.

Demonstrate strong understanding of the full lifecycle of platform and product development, focusing on continuous improvement and learning.

Translate reliability needs, reference architectures, and operational requirements into service-level objectives, runbooks, and production tooling. Be a valuable, flexible, and dedicated team member, supportive of teammates, and focused on quality and tech debt payoff.

Inspire and influence teammates and product teams through well-structured arguments and trade-offs supported by evidence. Create coherent narratives that align technical solutions with business objectives.

Build and maintain constructive relationships, fostering a culture of co-creation and shared momentum towards achieving product goals. Align diverse perspectives and drive consensus to create feasible solutions.
